content.summary_short: Phase 2 onboarding, spotlight routing, and division ownership for creator activation.

questions.q: When unsure which division owns delivery, you should:
choices: Escalate with context and ask for routing

lesson.objective: Route creative requests to the right division lane without overpromising delivery.
lesson.why_it_matters: Art Localized spans multiple divisions; wrong routing delays launches.
lesson.apply: Match three sample requests to division lanes in the quiz.
lesson.advance: Pass quiz; continue to ART-EP-2 — Partnership Tiers.
